title: AI slop attacks on the curl project - Daniel Stenberg
summary: Daniel Stenberg's keynote at FrOSCon 2025 on AI slop attacks on the curl project, with examples of bogus AI-generated security reports. He discusses the toll on maintainers and why various countermeasures don't fit the project.
why: HN points to it when discussing AI-generated bug reports and vibe-coded pull requests burdening open source maintainers.
